policy.text: Cost-to-cost, single performance obligation, fixed price

sources.text: Aster Robotics / Oakland deployment: fixed-price contract, total consideration $1,000,000. Single performance obligation: deliver, install and commission the robotaxi depot fleet. Milestone billing: acceptance $200,000.
Cost export through 2026-09-30. Incurred to date: $400,000.
Close 2026-03 (Fremont pilot): manager wrote 'Remaining Estimate 120k'. Confirmed: Remaining Estimate means future costs only, excluding incurred.
Close 2026-04 (Fremont pilot): 'Remaining Estimate now 90k'. Treated as future costs only; incurred unchanged.
Close 2026-05 (San Jose depot): 'Remaining Estimate 310k after lidar swap'. Remaining Estimate means future costs only.
Close 2026-06 (San Jose depot): 'Remaining Estimate 240k'. Future costs only; not a revised total.
Close 2026-07 (Phoenix depot): 'Remaining Estimate 500k'. Controller confirmed: future costs only.
Close 2026-08 (Phoenix depot): 'Remaining Estimate 410k'. Remaining Estimate means future costs only, as in every prior close.

proposal.explanation: Cost-to-cost: incurred $400,000 / est. total $800,000 = 50%. Cumulative revenue $500,000; billed $300,000; contract asset $200,000.
